results.evidence: Retry: the only route-level description (Wikipedia's Mount Adams article) says the east-side headwalls should be climbed early season because of rockfall, supporting May-June conditions, but gives no months. The Tract D non-member window itself is uncertain: recent summaries say the Yakama recreation area has opened only for about a month in late summer, which contradicts the row's own July 1-October 1 figure. No source states this route's season. Would be settled by a route-specific account (e.g. The Mountaineers' Adams ice routes page, which returned 403) or a Yakama Nation statement of current open dates.

results.evidence: Searches for a Mount Adams Wilson Glacier Headwall approach return only the Mount Rainier Wilson Headwall (Mountain Project, AAJ 1958 Schoening/Molenaar, SummitPost), which is a different route. No source describes how parties reach the Adams Wilson Glacier. Would be settled by a trip report or guide description of an actual Adams ascent.

results.fact: Access side: Cold Springs vs Yakama/Bird Creek
results.evidence: Wikipedia confirms the east flank and parts of the Round the Mountain Trail lie on the Yakama Reservation and may need special permits, but no source says which trailhead this route uses. Note: the rope_note's '30-50 degree slopes left of a central buttress' and III-IV grade may have been drawn from the Rainier Wilson Headwall, which should be reviewed. Would be settled by a documented Adams ascent naming its trailhead.

No external account of this route's descent exists in search results; the North Ridge and South Spur are the mountain's general walk-offs, but nothing ties either to this route. Internal agreement (descent_text, approach_variants, pro_tips, trailhead) favours the South Climb but the North Ridge wording appears in four places (descent, itinerary note, schedule, totalNote), so it is not overwhelming. Would be settled by any documented ascent's descent.

No source gives a distance for any Adams Wilson Glacier Headwall approach; the only 'Wilson Headwall' data found belongs to Mount Rainier. Would be settled by a documented approach distance for this route.

Mazamas rate the route for spring and summer, best early season. Every dated account found is from June or early July: an AAJ report (June 21-22, 1976), a ski descent in mid-June 2019 that said the bergschrund was opening and the line 'won't last much longer', and a June 23, 2020 north-side trip via Killen Creek. No source documents a May ascent or states the months, so neither 'Jun' nor 'May to June' is confirmed by two sources. Would be settled by a dated May ascent, or a source giving the window in months.

Mazamas give only their own letter grade (D, spring and summer); the 1976 AAJ report and the 2019 ski report give no grade. No source gives a YDS commitment grade (III vs III-IV). Would be settled by a guidebook-derived grade reproduced in two independent places.
